notes.title: RUTHLESS:1 is here
notes.notes:
Dear players,

[b]RUTHLESS:1 is finally in Early Access.[/b] I want to thank everyone, who has test-played any previous version of the game and everyone, who kept up with the development. You really kept me motivated.

Once again, I want to apologize for missing the initially planned release on Nov 1. Sometimes unplanned things get the better of one.  

Anyway, I hope you enjoy RUTHLESS:1 and I'm looking forward to your feedback. Please join the official Discord to keep up with the game and submit feedback: discord.gg/28DJ7TraRN

[b]You are amazing![/b] 

Greetings from Berlin,
Alex

notes.title: Notes on the planned Early Access launch
notes.notes:
You may have noticed that RUTHLESS:1 is planned to launch into Early Access on Nov 1. Due to some technical issues, this date may move back a few days, one week at most. I will inform you about a precise date as soon as possible.

But there's also news regarding the RUTHLESS:1 Demo: As soon as Early Access launches, the demo will be restricted to the first chapter of the game. So better give it a try now. If you have reached chapter two by then, you will be able to play the full chapter without restrictions, but new savegames won't be able to enter chapter two regardless.

Please stay tuned for more news.

Greeting from Berlin,
Alex

notes.title: RUTHLESS:1 is still alive
notes.notes:
First, let's address the elephant in the room. Yes, news about RUTHLESS:1 were basically non-existant in the last year. But fear not, it is still in active development, things were just slower than expected.

[b]What happened?[/b]
Lots of experimenting with new technologies led to some time consuming tasks and since RUTHLESS:1 is still a one-man-project, this had a much bigger impact than I imagined but the results were worth it.  Also, I noticed a lot of stuff that felt just not polished enough. A non-trivial amount of code was rewritten completely and lots of previously undetected bugs were fixed.

[b]What are the consequences?[/b]
While this was never officially announced, RUTHLESS:1 was planned to enter Early Access in June 2024. I want to offer a great experience with the game, so that target has become unattainable. I'm really sorry, and I want to apologize to anyone, who is waiting for a new version.

But you're probably waiting for that announcement. Here it comes: [b]RUTHLESS:1 will enter Early Access in Q4 2024[/b] and it will start at the small price of 5€ (may differ in regions with other currencies). Also, from now on, important milestones during development will be shared here, so stay tuned.


Greeting from Berlin,
Alex
